name: valve_c17_wall_blast
note: City 17's office wall blasts (d3_c17_12): an office whose outer walls are blown in at three places (Valve's striders shoot them): each section vanishes with explosions, a shake and flying wall chunks, a holed wall model takes its place, and the office's things (computers, file cabinets, a table) are thrown about

trigger.name: wall_blast_1
trigger.what: the north wall by the door is blown in (once)

trigger.name: wall_blast_2
trigger.what: the outer wall, first window is blown in (once)

trigger.name: wall_blast_3
trigger.what: the outer wall, second window is blown in (once)
